ValidationRule.description: When Sub Category is "Fee Related Queries", only the following Status values are permitted: Submitted, In Review, Closed, Rejected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Sub_Category__c, "Fee Related Queries"), NOT(OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Submitted"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "In Review"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Rejected") )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Fee Related Queries, the Status must be one of: Submitted, In Review, Closed, or Rejected.
